run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T16:03:58Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by a failed rollout of the checkout Deployment. At 2026-11-16T16:04:05Z the checkout Deployment created a new ReplicaSet (checkout-d75b77f99) whose container image is the malformed reference quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64 with an embedded newline before the tag 1.0.0. The kubelet cannot parse it, so the only new pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 stays Pending with container state waiting/InvalidImageName, while the previously working ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) was scaled from 1 to 0 at 16:04:08Z. From that point the checkout Service has only a notReady endpoint, so checkout stops producing PlaceOrder server spans (210 per 5m at 16:05Z, then 0 from 16:11Z) while frontend keeps calling it: frontend client spans grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and POST /api/checkout carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR (373.7 spans per 10m at 16:14Z, essentially all of frontend-proxy ingress errors at 378.9 per 10m). Envoy access logs show POST /api/checkout returning 500 while other routes return 200 in the same seconds, so the proxy itself is healthy and the 5xx comes from the frontend's failed checkout call. frontend-proxy and frontend pods are Running and Ready with 0 restarts, and no workload other than checkout was rolled during the window.

claims.text: frontend-proxy span metrics over the 80-minute window ending 16:24:54Z show 373.55 error spans on operation ingress and 364.39 error spans on router frontend egress, out of 20726.6 and 20734.8 total span counts respectively; these are span counts, not request counts, and STATUS_CODE_UNSET means no status was recorded.

At 16:14:00Z the 10-minute error-span increases were: frontend-proxy ingress 378.95 and router frontend egress 376.84; frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 373.68, POST /api/checkout 373.68 and POST 373.68; frontend tcp.connect 20. All other queried frontend operations (GET, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem) were 0, so nearly all frontend-proxy ingress errors in that interval follow the checkout call path.

The frontend-proxy ingress error burst starts right after the checkout rollout: the 5-minute error-span increase for frontend-proxy/ingress was 0 at 15:58:58Z, 16:00:58Z and 16:02:58Z, 1.11 at 16:04:58Z, then 80 at 16:06:58Z, 181.1 at 16:08:58Z, 190.4 at 16:10:58Z and 213.3 at 16:12:58Z; small baseline counts of 1.1 to 5.6 per 5m appeared at 15:46:58Z to 15:56:58Z.

checkout stopped producing server spans while frontend kept calling it: the 5-minute increase of checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans was 210 at 16:05:00Z, 112.2 at 16:07:00Z, 41.1 at 16:09:00Z and 0 from 16:11:00Z onward, while frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans continued at 190 to 220 per 5m (98.7 at 16:17:00Z). Over the 80-minute window checkout spans carry no ERROR status (all STATUS_CODE_UNSET): 786.8 for PlaceOrder, and 786.8 each for CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, PaymentService/Charge and orders publish.

The checkout Deployment pod template specifies container image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64 followed by an embedded newline before the tag 1.0.0, plus init container wait-for-kafka with image busybox:latest; its status is Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable and message Deployment does not have minimum availability.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout reports replicas 1, updated 1, readyReplicas null and unavailableReplicas 1; its only pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 is phase Pending with container checkout not ready, state waiting reason InvalidImageName, message stating Failed to apply default image tag for quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64 plus a newline and tag 1.0.0 with invalid reference format; its init container wait-for-kafka completed with exit code 0 at 16:04:16Z.

Two checkout ReplicaSets exist: checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 15:26:00Z, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, replicas 0) and checkout-d75b77f99 (created 16:04:05Z, image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64 with embedded newline plus tag 1.0.0, replicas 1, readyReplicas null). Among all 23 ReplicaSets in otel-demo, checkout-d75b77f99 is the only one created after 15:27:46Z, so no other workload was rolled during the incident window.

Kubernetes events record the transition: Deployment checkout scaled up replica set checkout-d75b77f99 from 0 to 1 at 16:04:05Z and scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0 at 16:04:08Z; kubelet logged Stopping container checkout for pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq and ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb logged SuccessfulDelete of that pod at 16:04:08Z; for the new pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 the kubelet logged 27 InspectFailed events (first 16:04:17Z, last 16:09:29Z) and 12 Failed/InvalidImageName events (first 16:04:17Z, last 16:06:19Z).

The checkout Service endpoints contain no ready addresses: its subsets hold only notReadyAddress 100.96.4.211 with targetRef checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68. The Service itself is ClusterIP 100.69.111.142, port 8080 to targetPort 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=checkout, which matches the pod labels, so the missing endpoints are caused by the pod never becoming Ready rather than by Service misconfiguration.

frontend-proxy access log lines at 16:12:50Z to 16:12:52Z show POST /api/checkout returning 500 via_upstream alongside POST /api/cart 200, GET /api/cart 200, GET /api/products/... 200 and GET /api/data 200 in the same seconds, so the proxy served other routes successfully and the 500s were specific to the checkout route; the returned view was limited to the newest 40 of 6177 matching lines.

The frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-t9gll and the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 are both phase Running with all containers ready and restartCount 0 (frontend-proxy container started 15:26:05Z), and both the frontend-proxy and frontend Deployments report 1 desired, 1 ready and 1 available replica.

fraud-detection was considered as a cause: pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-xwg9b has restartCount 1 with lastState terminated reason OOMKilled and exit code 137, finishedAt 2026-11-16T15:43:53Z. Rejected as this cause because the OOM happened about 20 minutes before the error burst, the pod is now Running and Ready, and its own error spans are confined to flagd ResolveInt and EventStream series (ResolveInt error increase was 0 over the 80-minute window); checkout server spans disappeared only with checkout's own pod replacement at 16:04:08Z.

A fault inside frontend-proxy or frontend was considered and rejected: both pods are Running and Ready with 0 restarts, the proxy returned 200 for non-checkout routes in the same seconds it returned 500 for /api/checkout, frontend's non-checkout operations recorded 0 error spans between 16:04Z and 16:14Z, and the failing spans are frontend client calls to oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder whose server side (checkout) had no ready endpoint.

Small error counts unrelated to checkout exist in the same window and do not evidence this cause: ad flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 3.05 error spans, recommendation flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 3.05 and fraud-detection EventStream 1.03 over the 80-minute window, plus frontend-proxy ingress error increases of 1.1 to 5.6 per 5m at 15:46:58Z to 15:56:58Z, before the checkout rollout.

Restore the checkout Deployment to the previously working image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, the image used by ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb, and remove the stray newline so the reference is valid, then confirm the new pod reaches Ready and the checkout Service endpoint list is populated.

Locate the manifest or Helm value that produced the image reference containing a newline and add validation, such as CI lint plus an admission policy, that rejects container image references containing whitespace or control characters, because the kubelet only failed at pod start while the Deployment still reported Progressing=True with reason NewReplicaSetAvailable.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not found: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for that name (status no_data), so its expression, lookback, threshold and the meaning of the reported value 2.0444444444444443 remain unverified, and whether the alert first fired on the pre-16:04 baseline errors or on the checkout rollout cannot be determined. The alert onset 16:03:58Z is about 7 seconds before the new ReplicaSet was created at 16:04:05Z.

Jaeger lists services frontend and frontend-proxy, but traces_search for frontend in 16:00Z to 16:10Z and traces_search_by_tags for frontend with error=true in 15:55Z to 16:15Z both returned no traces (status no_data), so span-level detail of the failing frontend to checkout call, such as its status message, is unverified.
A query for frontend-proxy ingress error spans over 13:00Z to 15:40Z returned no data (status no_data), so no longer pre-incident baseline is available for comparison.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what changed the checkout Deployment image and whether a pipeline produced the newline-terminated reference cannot be verified.

The frontend pod container logs returned no lines for 16:04Z to 16:12Z (status no_data) and its previous container instance does not exist, so application-side error text for the failing PlaceOrder calls could not be read; the deleted previous checkout pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq no longer exists, so its logs are unavailable.
The frontend-proxy log view was incomplete by limit (newest 40 of 6177 matching lines), so the full distribution of 5xx responses across the window is unknown.
next_steps: Revert otel-demo/checkout to image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, removing the embedded newline, and watch the rollout until the pod is Ready and the checkout Service endpoint list has a ready address.

Retrieve the RequestErrorRate alerting rule definition outside this Run to confirm its threshold and evaluation window, and assess whether a threshold above zero makes it fire on low-level background errors.

Audit the deployment source, such as the Helm release otel-demo values or the GitOps pipeline, for the change that set the checkout image to quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64 with a trailing newline, and add image-reference validation before manifests reach the cluster.
After recovery, re-check frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error spans and frontend-proxy ingress error spans to confirm the error rate returns to the pre-16:04Z level.
